name: audit-tests-and-check
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bash research/lane-i/validate.sh setup; bun test research/lane-i/validation-audit.test.ts research/lane-i/upper-bound/summarize.test.ts; bun run check

name: audit-prior-v8
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bash research/lane-i/validate.sh setup; set +e; bun research/lane-i/validation-audit.ts audit-input/prior-v8; code=$?; set -e; test -s audit-input/prior-v8/validation-audit.json; test "$code" -eq 1
